Macron Proposes Constitutional 'Golden Rule' for French Budget

French President Emmanuel Macron has proposed enshrining a 'golden rule' for the national budget within the constitution. This constitutional reform aims to cap government spending and control future deficits. The proposal echoes suggestions previously made by political opponents.
